pilot.W_pilot: query-level excluded share 0.2025 (21995 of 108591 2019 papers); candidate side not computed
pilot.evaluation_protocol: MRR of the held-out reference against 1,000 sampled negatives
pilot.negative_source: sampled: 1,000 earlier papers per source not cited by it (MRR)
pilot.notes: the older ogbl-citation was deprecated for a bug in its validation/test negatives
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: a 2019 paper is a source exactly when it has >= 6 in-subset references: all 86596 papers with >= 6 are sources and 0 of the 21995 non-sources have 6 or more; negatives are never later than the source (same year allowed), uniform over nodes (lower-degree half share 0.500)
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 'a subset of papers extracted from MAG'; source papers are 2019 papers, two references of each dropped for validation and test; negatives 'randomly-sampled from all the previous papers that are not referenced by the source paper'
pilot.sources_checked: Hu et al. 2020 NeurIPS (OGB, Sec. 5.4 and footnote 17); ogb.stanford.edu linkprop page; citation-v2.zip v1 (raw, split/time; CRC-checked)
pilot.verification: source rule verified exactly on the release; the paper subset rule needs MAG / OpenAlex
